one_liner_zh: AbbVie第二季財報營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於預期，年增率達10.16%，顯示核心業務動能強勁。
one_liner_en: AbbVie reported second-quarter revenue and EPS that both beat expectations, with 10.16% YoY revenue growth, demonstrating robust core business momentum.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，每股盈餘實際值3.65美元高於預估的3.61美元。
highlights_zh: 營收達169.9億美元，較去年同期成長10.16%
每股盈餘（EPS）為3.65美元，優於市場預期的3.61美元
核心免疫學與神經科學產品組合持續展現穩健需求
highlights_en: Revenue reached $16.99B, representing a 10.16% increase year-over-year.
EPS came in at $3.65, beating the consensus estimate of $3.61.
Core immunology and neuroscience portfolios continued to show solid demand.
risks_zh: 高達72.63的本益比可能隱含較高的估值壓力
面臨主要藥品專利到期的長期替代競爭威脅
risks_en: A trailing P/E ratio of 72.63 may imply elevated valuation pressure.
Long-term generic and biosimilar competition risks facing key mature drugs.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：本季財報優於預期展現基本面韌性，對短中期股價具正面支撐；後續應追蹤暢銷藥品銷售成長率及新藥研發管線進展。
ai_view_en: View: The earnings beat demonstrates fundamental resilience, providing positive support for the near-to-mid term stock price; key metrics to track include flagship drug sales growth and pipeline progress.
